# sarif-merge

> Merge SARIF 2.1.0 logs from several scanners into one: runs grouped by tool, rules merged with reindexed results, duplicates removed by fingerprint and baseline states marked Python package `trysac-sarif-merge`, import name `sarif_merge`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
